method: Direct inspection of generated images and the final labeled asset-sheet.png composited on a solid gray background for alpha review.
notes: prologue_01: exactly four distant cloaked survivors; burning village and steeple in the distance. First attempt was regenerated to remove the premature lodge, hats and staffs.
prologue_02: compact timber/stone gabled lodge, lone rear-view witch holding a lantern, snow and chimney smoke.
prologue_03: rounded seal stone with pictorial teal marks; timber floor above, amber light and three pairs of dim eyes. Magical marks are decorative shapes, not readable writing.
prologue_04: three travelers to the left, a spider silhouette and distant eyes to the right, continuous dusk-to-night scene.
title_bg: elevated three-quarter view, lodge on the center-right and dark menu space on the left.
witch_portrait and witch_locked: matching front-facing, above-knee portrait composition; gray on the sheet is a review backdrop, not part of either asset.
Optional title_logo.png omitted; the game's font fallback remains applicable.
